# Reference-runner membership final code quality review

**Verdict: PASS — final current owner component review.**

Source `5fbebd9df3a60b6c29e09f7236c1b916fe4c4418` remains clean and unchanged. There are no blocking code quality findings. The accompanying JSON retains all 23 reviewed file hashes, the 16 complete original fixture identities, unchanged canonical/census contracts and every command receipt/raw-log hash. I independently rehashed all 4,750 files under the unchanged seven Source pathspecs and checked all 14 command snapshots against the current files, full Git index and empty status.

Actual owner validation passes: normal locked compilation and tests report Fresh=false artifacts rooted in this worktree; the raw Cargo JSON matches the saved compiler bindings. All **136 xtask tests pass**, including **22 membership regressions**, with zero failures, ignores or filters. The earlier 18 and 19 test bodies remain byte-identical; the complete attributed originals and prior two failed review rounds remain intact.

The required repository wrapper `./script/clippy --locked -p xtask` passes with release/all-targets/all-features/deny-warnings checks scoped to xtask. Its optional cargo-shear step was unavailable and did not execute. Normal `cargo fmt --all -- --check` passes. The frozen normally built CLI is 50,893,168 bytes with SHA-256 `2e85cbaec3314218506512f52ac4c897b2bdd3abe27402adb7e2d183045de8ae`.

All **10 actual CLI flows** produce their expected results: create and exact check succeed; existing-output replacement, mismatched check, changed revision/path/length, duplicate identity, selection budget and changed original are rejected with the recorded errors. The negative exits are expected validation results. The final 53,129-byte evidence output retains null runtime cases, unresolved applicability, false global census completion and zero original behavior credit. The mismatched-check sentinel remains unchanged.

The Rust conventions, bounded error propagation, documentation and meaningful fixture/boundary coverage assessed in the static review remain sound. The reviewer ran no Cargo, compiler, cache, SDK/JVM/app or Source/Git mutation; only these external review reports were written. The owner runtime lease is released.

Current full-workspace CI, lead full-app validation, final evidence packaging/source equivalence and main/protected/conflict/integration guards remain pending. This component verdict does not declare the task or IDE complete and grants no app UI fidelity, startup/memory/large-project performance, compiled upstream runner membership, runtime-case or original behavioral parity credit.

The reviewer read hold is released.
